source: User walking estimates: Home to boarding stop towards BN, and the same durations from the alighting stop back home when returning. From TNT (already at a stop), no walking is added. Original three pins are user-provided; Thurn en Taxis locations are operator GTFS.

picard.name: Brussel Picard
picard.scope: Picard boarding stops towards Brussels North
picard.note: Five-minute walk from home to the supplied Picard reference pin. Individual bus boarding coordinates remain those of the operator.

shuttle.name: TNT shuttle stop
shuttle.note: Five-minute walk from home. This is the shuttle stop pin supplied by the user; the BN shuttle bay remains unspecified.

suzan.name: Suzan Daniel · Picard street
suzan.scope: All nearby Suzan Daniel platforms, including De Lijn, as approved by the user
suzan.note: The supplied reference pin is on Picard street. By user confirmation, the 8-minute walk is used as an area estimate for all nearby Suzan Daniel platforms. Each bus still uses its own actual boarding coordinates.

thurn.name: Thurn en Taxis · STIB 88
thurn.scope: Thurn en Taxis bus stop towards Brussels North
thurn.note: Eleven-minute walk from home, supplied by the user. This is the STIB bus stop, not the Tour-et-Taxis railway station or the TNT staff-shuttle stop. No personal reference pin was supplied; use the actual STIB boarding coordinates in the trip details.
